description: Manages embedded charts. action=add builds a chart from chart_type (COLUMN/BAR/LINE/AREA/STEPPED_AREA/SCATTER/PIE), domain_range (x-axis labels / pie labels), series_ranges (one grid range per data series; PIE takes exactly one) and optional title/legend_position/header_count (rows of the ranges treated as headers, default 1) — place it with anchor {sheet_id,row_index,column_index} (the cell under the chart's top-left corner) or new_sheet=true for its own chart sheet; the reply carries the new chartId. Ranges should be single columns (or rows) including the header cell. For chart kinds beyond the basic set (combo, waterfall, histogram, org …) pass a raw Sheets API ChartSpec via spec instead — it overrides the simplified fields. action=update REPLACES the whole spec of an existing chart (chart_id + the same spec-building fields; there is no partial chart update). action=delete removes the chart by chart_id. Find chartIds via get_spreadsheet (sheets[].charts).

action.description: What to do with the charts.

anchor.description: add: place the chart over the grid, top-left at this cell.

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId (NOT the title) from get_spreadsheet sheets[].properties.sheetId; the first sheet of a new spreadsheet is 0.

chart_id.description: update/delete: the chartId from get_spreadsheet or the add reply.

chart_type.description: add/update: the chart kind (required unless spec is given).

domain_range.description: The x-axis (or pie label) values, incl. header cell.

end_column_index.description: End column, exclusive (omit = to the last column).

end_row_index.description: End row, exclusive (omit = to the last row).

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId from get_spreadsheet (not the title).

start_row_index.description: First row, 0-based inclusive (omit = from the top).

header_count.description: How many leading rows of the ranges are headers (default 1).

legend_position.description: BOTTOM_LEGEND, LEFT_LEGEND, RIGHT_LEGEND, TOP_LEGEND or NO_LEGEND (default: API's choice).

new_sheet.description: add: put the chart on its own new chart sheet instead.

series_ranges.description: One range per data series, incl. header cells (PIE: exactly one).

items.description: Cell rectangle in grid coordinates: rows 1-10 × columns A-B = {start_row_index:0, end_row_index:10, start_column_index:0, end_column_index:2}.

end_column_index.description: End column, exclusive (omit = to the last column).

end_row_index.description: End row, exclusive (omit = to the last row).

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId from get_spreadsheet (not the title).

start_row_index.description: First row, 0-based inclusive (omit = from the top).

spec.description: Raw Sheets API ChartSpec — full control; overrides the simplified fields above.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.
